distinction: Adds an even, C1 basis supported only on pairs of negative coordinates. The previous odd tanh-product has nonzero support and opposite sign on mixed-sign coordinates; multiplicative gain cannot activate zero original features; compact one-dimensional residuals have no cross-derivative. Every original independent feature is retained separately. This is not a mean-spine or variance-rescaling variant.
numerical_requirements: Zero-init bitwise original output/input/router/post/geometry/projection gradients; nonzero Torch autograd and grouped matrix oracle with unchanged predeclared tolerances. Empty experts and padded rows covered at1/257/4096/16384 tokens plus untuned257 evaluation.
graph_requirements: Full24 graph warmup, eight original logical ranks, eight training updates with all five new coefficient banks learning, original evaluation math, normal/pending state restoration and bitwise next update. Projected seven-probe and sparse diagnostics<=3%.
diagnostic_requirements: Actual residual and feature changes, fraction of zero independent features newly activated, gradient/update magnitudes for added coefficients and original geometry/projections. Coefficient size alone is not activation effect.
